Creator: Zadibouc
Description:
Arjun Resupply has been one the most standard ways to play Arjun since set 2 and has the advantage not to be a Gift Deck (like the Quetzal version), giving him a unique gameplay rather than using the same cardpool as Turuun.

The deck is rather simple to understand; we want to resupply a lot with Aloe Vera, Floral Tent and Harvest, so that we can feed Arjun's power, and also find anchoring support effects. We have 11 support effets, 8 anchor and 3 sleep, to help keeping a strong board presence once the midgame starts. 

The main anchor targets are Inari, Aloe and Reka Investor for the Card/Mana advantage they give; a Corgi or a Skater can be secondary targets for their good stats.

We also run 3 Requiem and 2 Sap Duende as our interaction cards; they can be quite key against some matchups to answer various threats (Festival, The Hunger, Astrape).

I tried to keep cards complexity quite low by using a lot of vanilla cards or single line texts. We could lower complexity even more with Rare Cernunnos instead of Skaters or Investors, but it would also weaken a deck that is already quite in the lower tiers of competition.

Overall, I think it's a very enjoyable deck that offers a vast variety of playlines and can thrive when rightfully mastered. It is also quite thrilling to play Harvest rare and be dependent on the RNG of resupplying the cards you need; we're not throwing dice in Muna, but this deck can make you feel the same sometimes.
Description Claude Revised: A resupply-focused midrange deck built around fueling Arjun's power through repeated reserve refills. The strategy is to resupply aggressively using Aloe Vera, Floral Tent, and Harvest while anchoring key characters like Inari and Reka Investor for sustained card and mana advantage. The deck runs 11 support effects, 8 anchor effects, and 3 sleep effects to dominate the mid-to-late game board, with Requiem and Sap Duende as flexible interaction pieces. Harvest Rare adds an exciting RNG element, making each resupply feel impactful and different. The deck uses mostly low-complexity cards and is approachable for newer players, while offering deep play lines for those who invest time in mastering it.

Creator: Knightsong
Description:
The core strategy is to play aggressively, using low-cost creatures with good stats or effects to win expeditions and maintain tempo in combination with Nevenka's ability to boost/anchor your best cards when needed.

The key card in this deck is rare Martengale to avoid Nevenka's ability's downside but the card can also be used to buff other dice rolls such as Trickster, Snowball Commando, or Lyra Signet. 

Another key synergy are the return to hand effects from Inkcaster, Hathor, and Reka Guide, which can provide hand advantage while also cycling your key cards for their effects or lower hand cost.

For a starting hand, you want to look for a 1-cost card to play like Martengale or Magical Training and then a card like Inkcaster or Hathor to compete for expeditions while also being able to bounce back another card later for early tempo.

This works as a starter deck because it highlights the strongest aspect of Nevenka, using her hero ability to sneak expeditions wins at the last moment or anchor valuable cards. It also has a lot of synergy for the dice rolling theme that draws people to her in the first place, while aiming to keep the consequences of unlucky rolls to a minimum so that new players aren't discouraged by the mechanic.

The cards in this deck were all chosen for their synergies and relative ease of use and understanding. While there are certain synergy plays possible in this deck, a new player could also just as easily play out cards however they wish and will still be able to net value out of them. Cards are all 2x copies or above for simplicity and consistency.

The spells were selected so that a player will generally have viable options available to them to either gain more card advantage and maintain tempo or remove a key element from the opponent.

The deck also features at least one card from each of the first five sets, giving new players a glimpse into the breadth of the Altered game and universe, but without adding too many complicated mechanics at once.
Description Claude Revised: An aggressive tempo deck built around Nevenka's dice-rolling hero power, which boosts or anchors key characters at critical moments. The strategy is to win expeditions with efficient low-cost creatures while using Nevenka's ability to push for late-game expedition steals or lock down valuable characters. Rare Martengale neutralizes the downside of the hero power while also buffing other dice-roll cards like Trickster and Snowball Commando, and return-to-hand effects from Inkcaster, Hathor, and Reka Guide recycle key pieces for repeated value. All cards are run at two or more copies for consistency, and no card requires complex setup, keeping decision trees simple for new players. This deck is an ideal introduction to Nevenka, showcasing her dice-roll theme while minimizing the impact of unlucky rolls.
